summary.text: Cornered Tiger is Black Tigress's immortal killer move, used when she is at a disadvantage.

claims.text: Fighting Fang Yuan in divination tortoise form, Black Tigress evades vajra thoughts that scatter like rain and form a huge web of attacks. Realizing she is at a disadvantage, her aura bursts out and her toes land lightly on the ground. Black liquid spreads. After one breath the water expands to the size of a pond. After two breaths it bubbles. After three breaths a lizard the size of a horse emerges from the black water. The lizard is black with shiny eyes. It is not real; it is made from the dark path killer move. It moves rapidly, spreading its limbs and moving like the wind, bringing Black Tigress onto its back as she charges away. Compared with her, the transformed Fang Yuan looks very slow. Standing on the lizard she can move with ease, but she still cannot get past him to the damaged formation. He does not fall for feints, defends firmly, and continues to push her out.
